newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore trial of secure Internet payment scheme.
newsitem.headline: Singapore trial of secure Internet payment scheme.

text.p: Visa International said on Monday a pilot scheme for secure electronic payment of purchases made over the Internet would begin in Singapore early next year.
A Visa statement said it would issue cards to selected cardholders with the necessary encryption and identification code for the trial.
The trial would involve several thousand cardholders selected from four participating banks, United Overseas Bank Ltd, Citibank, Standard Chartered Bank and Development Bank of Singapore, it said.
The company said further pilots were planned for other Asia-Pacific markets.
It said the Singapore project would be conducted in conjunction with Singapore's National Computer Board, which has said it aims to make the republic a world leader in electronic commerce.
